new_value: Premise stale: the fragmenter/reassembler API is ALREADY public — lichen/subsys/schc/include/schc/schc.h:216-305 (schc_fragmenter_init/next/input/timeout, schc_reassembler_*, SCHC_OK, SCHC_FRAGMENT_RULE_A_TO_B) in the CONFIG_SCHC-gated Zephyr subsys lichen/subsys/schc; tests/fuzz/fuzz_schc.c consumes it via #include <schc/schc.h>. There is no schc_internal.h barrier (that header belongs to the separate lichen/subsys/lichen/schc compression subsys and contains only a micro-fragment codec). A wrapper layer would duplicate an existing public API — declined per simplicity bias. Remaining scope of parent b7z9.53.1 is the TX/RX wiring, tracked by its sibling bead (authenticated-fragmentation policy, blocked on l1qw.3.7.6.1).
